name: Agentic browser
note: Agent built into the browser itself
summary: The browser vendor builds the assistant into the browser instead of shipping it as an extension. It reads the open tabs and clicks, types and navigates in them with the user's own signed-in sessions, while the user watches and can take over.
how: The assistant lives in the browser's own UI, usually a side panel
It reads the current page and tabs the user points it to
It clicks, types and navigates in a tab the user can watch
Sensitive steps pause for confirmation or a take-over
facts: Perplexity Comet (Chromium-based), Gemini in Chrome (auto browse)
Uses the sites the user is already signed in to
Nothing extra to install, but the agent acts with the user's accounts
goodFor: Tasks on sites the user is already signed in to
Watching and taking over in the same window
watchOut: Every page the agent reads can carry a prompt injection
Local tasks stop when the device sleeps or closes
